title: Noah Lexi’s new single ‘Tell Me How’ is a cry from the depths of heartbreak
htmlContent: Noah Lexi opens his heart in "Tell Me How," the second song from his debut EP, Lavender. This project explores the ups and downs that come with love, especially when it's lost, and the journey of finding yourself again afterward. If Lavender represents the feelings of sadness, then "Tell Me How" is the emotional core of a moment when the pain of missing someone becomes overwhelming. Lexi's delivery is as if he's caught in his swirling thoughts, yearning for answers that may never arrive. "Tell Me How" is an intense question asked into the void, a heartfelt plea to know why something so powerful has slipped away. The subtle change in the music creates a backdrop for memories that are both painful to recall and impossible to forget. https://open.spotify.com/track/1wmJ0d4E3nIRBFw1JSMAtz?si=c3jIS5aoR_SC34pseUEGHw The sound balances simplicity and depth, allowing his sorrow to be felt, making "Tell Me How" connect with anyone who has experienced love and loss. This song serves as a mirror for those who have loved deeply, it encourages listeners to confront the pain and the space left behind. It also highlights the beauty in that sadness, showing that grieving such a profound love is a testament to having loved strongly in the first place. Follow on: Facebook/Instagram
